Porous structure design and mechanical behavior analysis based on TPMS for customized root analogue implant.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation Patient-specific
Kaile Song, Zhaohui Wang, Jing Lan, Songhua Ma Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials 2021-03-01 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2020.104222
单位: School of Mechanical Engineering, Shandong University, PR China.
通讯: Songhua Ma @ School of Mechanical Engineering, Shandong University, PR China; Shenzhen Research Institute of Shandong University, PR
相关性: 该论文直接针对增材制造生物医学植入物的应力遮挡问题，通过TPMS多孔结构设计降低弹性模量，并进行了力学测试和有限元验证。
边界: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or experimental osseointegration evaluation.
动机· 传统实心牙种植体弹性模量过高导致应力遮挡，需设计多孔结构以匹配骨组织。
方法· 基于TPMS设计不同孔隙率（30%-60%）的P和G结构立方样品，通过压缩实验和有限元分析评估力学性能与应力分布。
结果· 30%和40%孔隙率的P和G结构消除了应力遮挡效应，屈服强度高于皮质骨。
验证· 通过压缩实验测量杨氏模量、泊松比和屈服强度，结合FEA验证应力分布。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Solid dental implants cause stress shielding due to high Young's modulus, necessitating porous structures to match bone stiffness.
Method· P and G TPMS structures with four porosities (30%-60%) were designed, fabricated as cubic samples, and characterized via compression tests and finite element analysis for stress distribution.
Result· P and G structures with 30% and 40% porosity eliminated stress shielding and exhibited yield strengths exceeding cortical bone.
Validation· Experimental compression tests provided Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and yield strength; FEA validated the stress distribution at the bone-implant interface.
triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) · 三周期极小曲面root analogue implant (RAI) · 根形种植体stress shielding · 应力遮挡porosity · 孔隙率Young's modulus · 杨氏模量compression experiment · 压缩实验finite element analysis (FEA) · 有限元分析osseointegration · 骨整合Ti6Al4V · 钛合金
TPMS dental implant stress shielding LPBF porous structure root analogue implant

Key techniques for stress shielding effect of prosthesis implantation

High AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Yixin Shao, Tianmin Guan, Ye Zhu, Xiangyu Chen JOURNAL OF SHENZHEN UNIVERSITY SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING 2021-03-01 10.3724/sp.j.1249.2021.02201
单位: School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Beihua, Jilin 132021, Jilin Province, P.R.China
通讯: Yixin Shao @ School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Beihua, Jilin 132021, Jilin Province, P.R.China
相关性: 该论文直接研究3D打印钛合金多孔结构以匹配骨弹性模量，从而减轻应力遮挡效应，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration assessment.
动机· 解决3D打印钛合金假体与人体骨弹性模量不匹配导致的应力遮挡问题。
方法· 建立多孔结构模型，通过映射关系调控弹性模量，并优化打印参数。
结果· 当线能量密度为269.1 J/mm³时，弹性模量降至31.51 GPa；70%-80%孔隙率的金刚石结构可匹配皮质骨模量。
验证· 通过3D打印钛合金试样进行力学测试验证弹性模量。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address stress shielding caused by mismatch in elastic modulus between 3D-printed titanium alloy prostheses and human bone.
Method· A porous structure model was established to tune elastic modulus via mapping relationships, and printing parameters were optimized.
Result· Elastic modulus was reduced to 31.51 GPa at a linear energy density of 269.1 J/mm³; diamond structures with 70%-80% porosity matched cortical bone modulus.
Validation· Mechanical testing of 3D-printed titanium alloy specimens validated the elastic modulus.

Motivation· To estimate the effect of calcar-collar contact on periprosthetic fracture mechanics using a collared fully coated cementless femoral stem.
Method· Mechanical testing was performed on composite femurs implanted with a collared fully coated cementless stem, comparing groups with and without calcar-collar contact.
Result· Calcar-collar contact significantly increased construct stiffness and resistance to periprosthetic fractures.
Validation· Validation was conducted using composite femur models in a controlled mechanical testing setup.

Uniaxial compression mechanical behavior of Ti-6Al-4V hollow lattice structures

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Transferable Skim only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Huilan Ren, Haiting Shen, Jianqiao Li Scientia Sinica Technologica 2021-03-01 10.1360/sst-2020-0485
相关性: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V空心点阵结构的准静态力学性能，虽涉及增材制造和力学测试，但未涉及疲劳性能、表面粗糙度或骨整合评估，与用户方向部分相关。
边界: This paper does not cover fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration assessment, which are critical for biomedical implant applications.
动机· 研究不同强化结构分布对Ti-6Al-4V空心点阵准静态力学性能的影响。
方法· 设计三种空心点阵结构，通过实验和数值模拟分析其力学行为。
结果· 壁面强化结构显著提升弹性模量、极限强度和比强度，节点强化反而降低性能。
验证· 准静态压缩实验与有限元模拟对比验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the effect of strengthening-structure distribution on the quasi-static mechanical behavior of Ti-6Al-4V hollow lattice structures.
Method· Three types of hollow lattice specimens (basic, node-strengthened, wall-strengthened) were fabricated and tested under compression, with numerical simulations to study shape parameters.
Result· Wall-strengthened structures increased elastic modulus by 20%, ultimate strength by 49%, and specific ultimate strength by 13%, while node-strengthened structures reduced these properties.
Validation· Experimental quasi-static compression tests and finite element simulations were used to validate mechanical behavior.

Uncertainty Quantification by Ensemble Learning for Computational Optical Form Measurements

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Lara Hoffmann, Ines Fortmeier, Clemens Elster arXiv preprint 2021-03-01 link
相关性: 该论文展示了集成学习在逆问题中的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性评估。
边界: The paper focuses on optical metrology inverse problems, not on FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics, and lacks validation on mechanical/structural simulations.
动机· 为计算光学测量中的逆问题提供可靠的不确定性量化。
方法· 采用集成学习扩展深度学习求解逆问题，并系统插入分布外误差和噪声评估可靠性。
结果· 集成方法在高维真实数据上实现了可信预测。
验证· 通过人工添加分布外误差和噪声数据进行数值验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To provide reliable uncertainty quantification for a large-scale nonlinear inverse problem in computational optical form measurements.
Method· Ensemble learning is used to extend a deep learning approach for the inverse problem, and reliability is assessed by systematically inserting out-of-distribution errors and noisy data.
Result· The ensemble method yields trustworthy predictions on high-dimensional real-world data.
Validation· Validation is performed numerically by adding synthetic out-of-distribution errors and noise to the data.

Reduced-order modeling of advection-dominated systems with recurrent neural networks and convolutional autoencoders

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Romit Maulik, Bethany Lusch, Prasanna Balaprakash Physics of Fluids 2021-03-01 10.1063/5.0039986
单位: Argonne Leadership Computing Facility, Argonne National Laboratory 1 , Lemont, Illinois 60439, USA
通讯: Romit Maulik @ Argonne Leadership Computing Facility, Argonne National Laboratory 1 , Lemont, Illinois 60439, USA
相关性: 该论文提出的CAE+RNN降阶方法可迁移至生物力学FEA替代模型，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
边界: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification, and no constraint handling for design optimization.
动机· POD-Galerkin方法难以处理对流主导PDE的低维表示
方法· 使用卷积自编码器降维，循环神经网络进行时间演化
结果· 仅需2维潜空间即可复现粘性Burgers方程的激波剖面
验证· 在Burgers方程和浅水方程数值基准上验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Proper orthogonal decomposition with Galerkin projection fails to capture advection-dominated dynamics due to truncation of higher-order mode interactions.
Method· A convolutional autoencoder compresses the high-dimensional state into a low-dimensional latent space, and a recurrent neural network evolves the latent dynamics in time.
Result· A two-dimensional latent space accurately reproduces sharp shock profiles for the viscous Burgers equation, and a six-dimensional latent space captures the inviscid shallow water equations.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks on the viscous Burgers equation and inviscid shallow water equations demonstrate superior performance over POD-Galerkin.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve the approximation quality of variational inference for diffusion processes beyond simple proposals.
Method· Constructs the variational process as a controlled prior and reduces smoothing to a deterministic optimal control problem via moment closure and path-wise Fisher information.
Result· Proposes a natural gradient descent optimization that accommodates state-dependent diffusion and recovers Gaussian process approximations as a special case.
Validation· Theoretical derivation and recovery of classical Gaussian process approximation as a special case.

Motivation· To evaluate mid-term clinical and radiographic outcomes of a femoral-saving stem in total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective study of 188 hips in 175 patients assessed Harris Hip Score, Kaplan-Meier survivorship, stress shielding, and radiological signs at minimum 3-year follow-up.
Result· Stable fixation was achieved in 95.2% of cases, stress shielding was predominantly first degree (75.5%), and subsidence occurred in 2.7% of hips.
Validation· Validation was based on clinical and radiographic follow-up data from a single-institution cohort.

Validation· Validated through simulation studies and a large-scale meta-analysis of 81 publications on AML patients.

动机· 评估PFNA2髓内钉治疗不稳定股骨转子间骨折的临床效果。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the clinical effectiveness of PFNA2 intramedullary nailing for unstable peritrochanteric fractures.
Method· A prospective study of 66 patients with minimum 12-month follow-up, using Harris Hip Score for functional assessment.
Result· PFNA2 demonstrated good stability with mean Harris Hip Score improving from 75.35 at 6 months to 82.02 at 12 months.
Validation· Clinical follow-up and complication documentation.
